caveat: Its reference list shows 'cross-disciplinary' to mean researchers from different disciplines rather than societal actors, and the evaluation frame is Kirkpatrick training evaluation, so participation is handled as facilitation rather than power-sharing.
source: Springer article listing: Systemic Practice and Action Research
title: A Structured Model for Designing and Evaluating Cross-Disciplinary Co-Creation Workshops
why: A design-and-evaluation model for cross-disciplinary co-creation workshops, built on soft systems methodology and training-evaluation logic. Testable straight away against 'Substrate Matters' and the CDC Urban Innovation sessions.
